claims.statement: On a finite connected graph with n≥2 ports and m≥1 seams, independently uniform seam selection and fair native integer endpoint repair almost surely selects the adjacent-level class at conserved total Q=nb+k. A public bounded input region plus sufficiently large initially empty native reservoir guarantees absolute 0/+1 or 0/-1 units. Complete current records and a known initial vacuum datum reconstruct absolute load histories through actual-edge tree probes; capped probe failures remain inconclusive. The selected transport is symmetric exclusion, with stationary mean squared current k(n-k)/(n(n-1)) and conditional nonzero-event probability D(x)/(2m). Same-geometry swap/hold preserves multi-loads. Integrality is a supplied alphabet property and earns no selection credit; no physical electric coupling or SI charge is established by this finite theorem.

claims.statement: For a connected N-port core with Laplacian gap at least mu>0, multiply its seam weights by c and attach two equivalent leaves of weight w with mutual seam weight v>0, with c>0 and w>0. With w=2Nv and c*mu>w+2v+2w(2N+3)(N-1)/N, the antisymmetric leaf contrast is the unique lowest nonconstant Laplacian mode with eigenvalue w+2v, equivalently the slowest nonconstant transfer mode. The native one-particle transfer is I-L/(2W). A variational proof bounds every orthogonal mean-zero mode, and exact endpoint counts verify the transfer and compact eigenvector for three core sizes. This is a source spectral construction; dynamical state acquisition and an operational energy measurement are separate assertions.

The geometry-preserving always-swap law yields exactly positive unit visibility under the same optical reader, while committed records remove the strong signed fringe. Periodic native plane filters retain their failures and pass the tested phase-error set delta in {0,+0.01,-0.01} radians on the stated uniform-input audit. A separate complete M=8 stationary-reference test retains the same native one/two-turn signs at much weaker visibilities (-4.13474e-5,+8.54752e-10), with positive swap-law controls. These are conditional planar observer-frame holonomy records, with complete postselection costs, not a general spatial spin representation or a sampled rare-herald experiment.

claims.statement: On one connected bounded-integer native graph with explicit core, target/copy triangles, blank reference pair and two marker rings, a current-selected core unit is routed into the target and undergoes source cooling and a finite positive-frequency counter. Its actual mixed state, including residual negative-frequency weight and coherent cross terms, passes through complete probabilistic arc-to-position erasure, fine observer-frame rotation, finite re-encoding and native copy transport. Conditional on the filed successful classical charge/routing prefix, 112 cases at B=2, M in {4,8}, epsilon=2^-k for k=0 through 6, both orientations and one/two turns give negative one-turn and positive two-turn native fringes, with positive always-swap rotation-stage controls; charge and clock preparation stay native in those controls. The same native ticket embedding has the proved bounded positive-frequency word limit for every integer k>=0, independently of the finite state-purity checks. A bounded cosine reader uses actual complete Ramsey probabilities and an explicitly audited impurity certificate: fixed single eta=0.002 and pair eta=0.01 pass on the executed domain. Two independently current-selected local sources are admitted on 110/158-port connected graphs, with all 2178 joint native columns checked in both address orders and complete product preparation outcomes. On the admitted bounded frequency sectors, their product-clock limit has the sum of the corresponding signed single-copy generators under the one fixed limiting calibration; the unpopulated W=-I padding is outside that chart. Exact additive source predictions, bounded record intervals and finite-shot uncertainty are distinguished. A separately frozen pair reader combines strides 1 and 8, enumerates every cosine branch compatible with the first recorded interval and [0,pi], and uses no source frequency in its decoder. With eta=0.01 and deterministic per-binary probability allowance 1e-5, all 112 cases have a unique component and all 1792 perturbation corners retain containment. At k=6 the conservative envelope union is contained in [1020.9461,1022.5509] keV, includes the finite 1022.00831724 keV source prediction and excludes the earlier 1024.45084870 keV pair reading under its original convention. The ill-conditioned four-pole diagnostic supplies no weak-pole precision. The complete graph, apparatus, all complements and conditional success costs are declared; the decode/rotation/re-encoding sequence is a same-state measurement connection and can change clock mixtures.
